# Why the thing does the broken thing

**Status:** verified
**Applies to:** Monster TULPAR T6 V2.1 (AI Creator)
**Verified on:** Ubuntu 26.04 · kernel 7.0.0-15 · 2026-09-15
**See also:** [the style guide](../STYLE.md)

## In short

Three sentences. The mechanism, the consequence, and the one thing a reader
should remember if they read nothing else.

## The mechanism

How the parts actually fit together — the daemon, the kernel module, the
firmware, whatever is really at fault. Diagrams and tables are welcome here
in a way they are not in a how-to.

## How this was diagnosed

The story, including the wrong turns. What looked like the cause and was not,
which measurement settled it, and what the cheap test is for the next person
who sees the same shape of failure.

## What does not fix it

Every plausible fix that was tried and failed, with the reason. A negative
result you keep is an evening someone else does not lose.
